discordPostHtml:
Download: https://github.com/Zanagrave/Mods/raw/main/SCAV-CO%20Ship%20Works.rar
Forum link: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=29449.msg431430#msg431430
A large ship/weapon/portrait that adds loads of combat salvaging ships, very deadly pirate ships and a few new hull-mods and portraits.

UPDATE: 8 Updated SCAV-CO hulls with more fitting shield and engine colors/venting colors, did some light weapon and ship balancing, reworked all the descriptions of all ships, weapons and hull mods... some are even more concerning than before!

Updated the Ultima, the giant white egg looking thing, it now has more fighter slots, two massive built-in burst cannons (one on ether side)(Balancing feed back on these cannons is welcomed)
